summary: SESSION_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION: user requested continuation, testing and protected merging of a local alternative. Fix actual OneDev offline Wellman packaging failure while preserving real wheel/runtime tests and candidate network isolation.

Missing prerequisites fail promptly and clearly; CI provisions exact build-tool pins and runs a real clean-venv negative regression. Independent exact-head publication and actual OneDev canary confirm the correction.

architecture.decision: Use current trusted installed setuptools/wheel with pip no-build-isolation/no-index/no-deps, keeping wheel build and isolated installed-runtime tests. interfaceChanges: Packaging regression now requires preinstalled build tools with a stable fail-fast diagnostic

Native exact-base/head governance, actual OneDev and required hosted Linux/Windows checks; trusted independent review/merge.
